content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at PGIMER is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific reporting times.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident position at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER).

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or equivalent, an MD (General Medicine) or equivalent postgraduate qualification, and be registered with the Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an age limit for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for the Senior Resident positions is 45 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, registration certificates, and self-attested copies of these documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident positions will be as per the rules and regulations of PGIMER.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the PGIMER office in Chandigarh. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a regular or ad-hoc appointment?
faq.answer: The job type for these Senior Resident positions is Ad-hoc.
